lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> that quickly dodges the {{opponent}}'s
<c:ffff00>attack<c> just before it lands.
Unlike <c:ffff00>defending<c>, it depends on probability: the
higher the <c:ffff00>Evasion Power<c>, the easier it is to
succeed. On success, no <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> or effects such as
<c:ffff00>negative statuses<c> are received; on failure, the <c:ffff00>legs<c>
<c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> takes {{damage}}.
The {{damage}} taken is reduced slightly by the normal
<c:ffff00>Defense Power<c>.
